limitations: No physical Android or browser performance, thermal or gameplay-route validation. Four-light override is desktop only.
110 checks pass in each main lifecycle configuration; Forward+ never creates batches.

Nine pixels remain in the combined shadow/contact map capture, maximum channel delta 34/255; original restoration is exact there. Separate shadow-only restoration can differ by the same nine pixels, and contact-only comparison has three. Exact cause unresolved.

Forward+ lifecycle fixture reports seven leaked Texture RIDs with a temporary ReflectionProbe. Omitting that probe yields 105 checks with no warning. Production manager creates no textures and bypasses Forward+.
One Forward+ map run failed to settle grass within the fixture limit; excluded. A retry settled and completed with exact pixels and unchanged draws.
Manager CPU time is not GPU frame time or a whole-game FPS gain. Benchmark reports exit zero when measurements finish even if pixels differ.
Initial failed eligibility and moving-object experiments are retained in QA, not accepted results. Movers now retain their original instances.
